articles.title: Is Personalization Making Prices Higher?
articles.summary: The escalating cost of living and rising food prices are significant national concerns, generating widespread public debate, notably on platforms like Reddit. Coffee prices are highlighted as a particular flashpoint for consumer grievances. The article suggests that beyond surface-level complaints, there are deeper, underlying factors contributing to these economic pressures, warranting further analysis into the root causes of these cost increases.

articles.title: Greenwich Entertainment Acquires ‘Peter Asher: Everywhere Man,’ Documentary On British Music Legend Tied To McCartney, Ronstadt, James Taylor
articles.summary: Greenwich Entertainment has acquired U.S. rights for 'Peter Asher: Everywhere Man,' a feature documentary. The film focuses on the illustrious career of British pop star, producer, and manager Peter Asher, celebrated for his pivotal contributions to the music industry. This acquisition represents a significant development in the international entertainment sector, highlighting cultural cross-border interest in music legends, which is important for general awareness.

articles.title: MGNREGA job cards to be used for work under new law to ensure smooth transition: Official
articles.summary: The government is rolling out a new rural employment scheme, "Viksit Bharat- Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin)." This initiative will enable existing MGNREGS job cardholders to access work opportunities. The scheme aims to bolster rural livelihoods and contribute to national development by ensuring continued employment guarantees, reflecting a strategic step towards enhancing socio-economic stability across rural India.

articles.title: Race Into Action with McFarlane Toys New DC Comics Flash Figure
articles.summary: McFarlane Toys has unveiled new DC Comics Page Punchers figures, expanding their popular collectible series within the DC Multiverse. This product launch reflects global consumer trends in character merchandise and the dynamic international toy market. It highlights cross-border commerce and brand influence, crucial for understanding the broader landscape of international business and cultural impact.

articles.title: Tom King Was To Finish Frank Miller And Jim Lee's All Star Batman
articles.summary: The article discusses creative plans for DC Comics' 'All-Star Batman' series. It reveals writer Tom King's intention to conclude a story arc originally started by legendary comic creator Frank Miller, with artist Jim Lee also contributing. This offers insight into evolving narratives and significant collaborations within the popular Batman universe, impacting future storylines for fans.

articles.title: From being hosted in a civil area to Bhairav Battalion debut - the many firsts at Army Day Parade
articles.summary: The 78th Army Day Parade was historically held in Jaipur, marking the first time this annual marquee event moved outside a cantonment area. This significant shift aimed to enhance public engagement and showcase the Indian Army's strength and commitment directly to citizens. The move fosters stronger civil-military relations, allowing more people to witness military prowess and feel national pride, reflecting the Army's evolving outreach strategies.

articles.title: Congress has two dozen lawmakers 80 or older; more than half seeking re-election in 2026: report
articles.summary: In US politics, a notable trend sees some prominent elderly members of the House and Senate (aged 80+) opting against re-election. Conversely, several other octogenarian lawmakers are actively campaigning to retain their seats. This dynamic highlights ongoing debates surrounding the role of age, experience, and leadership effectiveness within American legislative bodies, prompting discussion on political longevity.
